definition: The learned numerical parameters of a neural network that determine how it transforms inputs into outputs.
details: Weights are adjusted during training via optimization algorithms like gradient descent, and collectively encode everything the model has 'learned' from its training data.
story: Picture an architect laying out a building where every room has to know which other rooms matter to it. In plain words: The learned numerical parameters of a neural network that determine how it transforms inputs into outputs. Here is how it actually plays out: Weights are adjusted during training via optimization algorithms like gradient descent, and collectively encode everything the model has 'learned' from its training data. It is the difference between a row of isolated cubicles and one big room where everyone can hear each other. That blueprint is Model Weights.
